title: Booking: Links I made now shows what really happened, and you can cancel the call
text: On Booking, Links and calls, each row of Links I made now says what really happened: Waiting, Booked (with the day and time), Cancelled by you, or Cancelled by the booker. A booked row has a Cancel the call button: it asks you to confirm, and Calendly emails the booker. Pointing at a name shows their card. When you make a link you can choose what the booker is asked: let the system decide, the full questions, or just the short note. The questions are shown, and are edited in Calendly.
points: Open Booking, then Links and calls, and look at Links I made
Point at a name to see their card
On a booked row, click Cancel the call twice to confirm
When you make a link, pick what the booker is asked
